summary: Barclays PLC filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notice of redemption and cancellation of listing for its $1.75 billion 2.279% Fixed Rate Resetting Senior Callable Notes due 2027 (ISIN US06738EBU82). The company will redeem the notes at par on November 24, 2026, plus accrued interest from May 24, 2026; NYSE listing is cancelled on or shortly after that date. The Bank of New York Mellon acts as trustee and paying agent. This is a routine debt redemption, not a special situation. Watch for settlement mechanics only.
